reviews.name: 홍밥풀
reviews.content:
혹시 작은 공 좋아하는 강아지 있나요? 🐶🍅
그렇다면 당장 강쥐에게 이 방울토마토 장난감 세트 꼭 사주세요!!

강아지들 입 크기에 딱 맞는 작은 사이즈라 물고 놀기 좋고, 삑삑 소리도 시원하게 잘 나요.
동그란 모양이라 데굴데굴 잘 굴러가서 공놀이하듯 던져주며 놀기에도 딱입니다. ><

게다가 4개 세트가 만 원 초반대면 진짜 저렴한 편 아닌가요? 바잇미 장난감은 퀄리티는 몇만 원짜리 같은데 가격은 완전 저렴해잉!
혹시 4개는 많다 싶으면 옆집 강아지랑 반띵으로 나눠가지면 더욱 저렴해진다는 사실~~

하지만 푸리밥씨는 욕심쟁이라 나눠 갖지 않고 4개를 모두 차지했어요ㅋ.ㅋ
하나씩 던져줘도 잘 놀지만, 4개 한 번에 와랄라 던져주면 신나서 난리나니 4개 한 번에 던지면서 꼭 놀아줘보세요!!
reviews.content_en:
Do you have a dog that likes small balls? 🐐🍅
If so, you absolutely need to get your pup this cherry tomato toy set right now!!

The small size is perfect for dogs' mouth shapes, so it's great for chewing and playing with, and the squeaky sound comes out really nicely.
Since it's round, it rolls really well, so it's perfect for throwing and playing fetch-style! ><

Plus, a 4-pack for just over 10,000 won is really affordable, right? BITE ME toys have quality like toys that cost tens of thousands of won, but the price is super cheap!
If you think 4 is too many, you can split them with your neighbor's dog to make them even more affordable~~

But Poori-bap is greedy and didn't share, taking all 4 for himself ㅋ.ㅋ
Even throwing one at a time keeps him playing, but when you throw all 4 at once, he goes wild and crazy, so definitely try throwing all 4 at once and playing with him!!

reviews.content_en:
#Experience

BITE ME Rainbow Cherry Tomato Latex Toy

✅️ Soft latex material
✅️ Squeaky sound isn't too loud, so it's not annoying
✅️ Perfect size for small mouths to bite
✅️ Rainbow-colored cherry tomato design

The squeaky sound also isn't overstimulating, so it's great for playing with at home.
Thanks to the colorful rainbow colors, it's so cute when taking photos too ✨

Our favorite toy for our house is now officially the rainbow cherry tomato!

reviews.name: 임****
reviews.content:
#체험단 

1.사이즈 
기존에 가지고 있던 빅페이스 젤리곰 라텍스 장난감(가운데), 프렌즈 라텍스 장난감(오른쪽)과 비교해 봤어요. 이전에 가지고 있던 장난감들은 납작하고 넓었다면, 방울토마토 장난감은 동글동글 진짜 방울토마토 정도의 크기였어요. 8kg강아지가 한입에 물고 놀기 딱 좋은 크기라 너무 마음에 들었습니다. 대형견 친구들에게는 사이즈가 좀 작을 수도...?

2.소리
기존에 있는 두 라텍스 토이는 소리가 좀 있는 편인데, 이 제품은 소리가 그렇게 크지 않아서 한밤중에도 가지고 놀기 좋아요. 

3.가성비 
4개의 장난감이 한팩에 들어있어서 가성비가 좋아요. 한개를 샀는데, 4개나 들어있다?! 최고 아닙니까! 

4.기호성 
너무 좋아요. 라텍스 재질도 좋고 말랑말랑해서 강아지가 물고 놀기 좋아요. 일단 던지면 말벌아저씨 처럼 뛰어와요.
reviews.content_en:
#Experience

1. Size
I compared it with the Big Face Jelly Bear latex toy (middle) and Friends latex toy (right) that we already had. The previous toys were flat and wide, but the cherry tomato toy was round like an actual cherry tomato. It's the perfect size for my 8kg dog to bite with one mouth, so I loved it. Though it might be a bit small for large breed pups...?

2. Sound
The other two latex toys we have make some noise, but this product doesn't have too much sound, so it's great to play with even in the middle of the night.

3. Value for Money
4 toys come in one pack, so the value is great. I bought one, and there are 4 in it?! Best deal ever!

4. Preference
Love it so much. The latex material is great and it's soft, so my dog loves biting and playing with it. Once you throw it, he comes running over like a wasp.

reviews.name: 감****
reviews.content:
말랑말랑하고 알록달록 동글동글...

한입에 앙! 하고 물기 좋은 사이즈여서 소형견들도 너무 좋아할만 한 라텍스에요.
라텍스는 또 씹는 맛이 있어야 강아지들이 좋아하는데
요 방울토마토 라텍스는 말랑말랑하고 부드러워서 씹기도 너무 좋아요!

그리고 무엇보다도 보호자 입장에서는 생긴게 너무 귀여워서
안살수가 없어요,,,♡
reviews.content_en:
Soft, colorful, and round...
The cherry tomato latex that our Gamja loves so much ♡

Since it comes in a 4-pack set, when one latex toy disappears, we can take out a new one!

It's the perfect bite-sized toy that small breeds will absolutely love.
Latex toys need that chewing texture for dogs to really like them,
and this cherry tomato latex is so soft and fluffy that it's really fun to chew!

And most importantly, from a pet parent's perspective, it's so cute that
you just can't help but buy it... ♡

reviews.name: 이****
reviews.content:
1일1공 하시는 말괄량이신데 #바잇미 #체험단 덕분에 귀여운 공 받아부렸으요!!
삑삑하는 소리에 강아지 환장하는거 말해모함니까?ㅠㅠ 
ㅋㅋㅋ 소리도 안내고 그냥 덜렁 꺼냈을 뿐인데.. 바로 냄새 맡더니 자기꺼라고
빨리 주라고 시키지도 않은 앉아 자세로 버티다가 안주니까 두발루 일어나 버렷어요
크기가 작은 편이라 소형견 전~혀 문제없이 사용하실 거 같고(오히려 더 오래 잘 사용하실지도..)
20kg 공주한테도 얼추 잘 맞네요 ㅎ ㅎ 놀이터에 공 가져가서 완전 인기쟁이 됏지 모에요!
바잇미 토이들은 일단 너무 기엽기때문에 다 사라지면 다시 재구매의사 있을 유 입니다!
reviews.content_en:
My little rascal does one ball a day, and thanks to #BITE ME #Experience, I got some cute balls! 😍
You know how dogs go crazy for that squeaky sound?ㅠㅠ
ㅋㅋㅋ There was no sound and I just casually pulled it out... but he smelled it and knew it was his,
without me even asking, he stayed in a sit position waiting, and when I didn't give it, he stood up on his hind legs!
Since it's a smaller size, small breeds have absolutely no problem using it (might even last longer actually..)
It also fits well with my 20kg princess too ㅎ ㅎ She became the star of the playground with her ball!
BITE ME toys are so cute that if they disappear, I'd definitely repurchase them!

reviews.name: 공****
reviews.content:
배송 오자마자 감자에게 줘봤는데 생각보다 훨씬 좋아해서 만족스러워요 👏🏻
토마토 모양이 귀엽고 색감도 선명해서 그런지 보자마자 관심을 보였고, 물었을 때 나는 삑삑 소리 덕분에  한참을 가지고 놀았어요 😛 
라텍스 소재라 비교적 부드럽고 가벼워서 소형견도 부담 없이 물고 다니기 좋고, 던져주면 신나게 뛰어가 물어오는 모습이 정말 귀여워요 🤍
크기도 적당해서 입에 물기 편해 보였고, 장난감 자체가 말랑말랑해 흥미를 잃지 않고 오래 가지고 노는 점이 좋아요~
디자인과 실용성을 모두 갖춘 장난감이에요🍅
reviews.content_en:
I gave it to Gamja right after it arrived and she loved it way more than I expected, so I'm really satisfied! 👏🏻
The tomato shape is cute and the colors are so vibrant that she showed interest right away, and thanks to the squeaky sound it makes when she bites it, she played with it for a while 😛
Since it's latex material, it's relatively soft and light, so small breeds can bite and carry it around without burden, and it's so cute watching her run excitedly to fetch it when you throw it 🤍
The size is just right so it's easy to bite, and since the toy itself is soft, she doesn't lose interest and plays with it for a long time~
It's a toy that has both design and functionality 🍅

reviews.content:

reviews.content_en:

reviews.content_en: I got selected for the experience program and received it! Wow~ it's so so cute! It's the perfect size ball for small breeds like our Manju ^^ Manju keeps asking me to throw it! The colors are so vibrant and bouncy~ Highly recommend. Manju loves it too!
